titulo: Conjugate regular -ar verbs in the present subjunctive
subtitulo: The stem comes from the yo form, and the a turns into e: hable, hables, hablemos.
regla: Take the present-tense yo form, drop the -o and add -e, -es, -e, -emos, -en. -ar verbs switch to e.

bloques.texto: Regular **-ar** verbs in the present indicative are also regular in the **present subjunctive**. The stem is the same as the **yo** form of the present (**yo trabajo**), and the **-o** is replaced with the subjunctive ending.
Notice: **-ar verbs switch to the vowel e**. **-er** and **-ir** verbs do the opposite and switch to **a**: see [[5151|-er and -ir in the subjunctive]].

Watch the spelling: to keep the same sound, **-car** becomes **-que** (**busque**), **-gar** becomes **-gue** (**pague**) and **-zar** becomes **-ce** (**empiece**). Each has its own lesson: [[5724|-car]], [[5725|-gar]] and [[5726|-zar]].
Tip: the subjunctive is the world upside down. What was **a** becomes **e**: **hablas**, **hables**.

lista.en: Beto wants me to speak more slowly.
I hope you surf well on Saturday.

lista.es: El doctor le recomienda que ==camine== mucho.
lista.en: The doctor recommends that he walk a lot.
We may have dinner late today.
We have to tidy up when they finish.
I hope you visit the garden.
I want you to talk to your dad.

bloques.texto: What triggers the subjunctive in these sentences? [[5059|**querer que**]], [[6076|**esperar que**]], [[5061|**ojalá**]], [[5084|**tal vez**]] and [[5062|**cuando** about the future]]. Each has its own lesson.
Because the **-ar** subjunctive ends in **e**, it looks like the ordinary present of an **-er** verb. With verbs that are spelled almost the same, it's easy to get lost.

filas.t: Es posible que ellas crean un estilo nuevo.
Es posible que ellas creen un estilo nuevo.

lista.nota: **Crear** (_to create_) is **-ar**: subjunctive **creen**. **Crean** is the ordinary present.

filas.t: No creo que ellas crean eso.

lista.nota: This one is right: **creer** (_to believe_) is **-er**, and its subjunctive is **crean**. See [[10757|**crear**, **creer** and **criar**]].

filas.t: Quiero que tú hablas con Beto.
Quiero que tú hables con Beto.

lista.nota: After **quiero que**, never the ordinary present.

lista.texto: After a trigger with **que**: wishes, advice, doubt.
The negative **tú** command is this same form. See [[9255|negative commands]].
**Nosotros** as _let's_. See [[6961|commands for usted, ustedes and nosotros]].
The **usted** command comes from here too.
The stem always comes from **yo**. Review [[5492|-ar in the present]].
The other half: [[5151|-er and -ir in the subjunctive]].
If **yo** is irregular, so is the subjunctive: [[6000|yo-go verbs]].
The next step, the past: [[5068|the imperfect subjunctive]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: **Trabajar** with **nosotros**: El jefe quiere que ___ el sábado.
lista.r: El jefe quiere que trabajemos el sábado.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I hope you rest tonight._ (tú, **descansar**)
Which one? **Es posible que ellos crean un huerto** or **Es posible que ellos creen un huerto**.
lista.r: Es posible que ellos creen un huerto.
